entries.basis: The Finnish National Library (Helka) record helka.9914865583506253 describes a 29-page illustrated monograph, Studia Orientalia 51:1 (Helsinki, 1978; ISBN 951-95074-3-4), whose full title is 'A Syriac incantation bowl in the Finnish National Museum, Helsinki: a specimen of Eastern Aramaic koiné'. It is devoted to one bowl.
